title: サステイナブル建築
subtitle: Sustainable Architecture
keywords: Resource recycling society 2.Global environment and energy issues 3.Long life and reuse of building 4.Building evaluation 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Learn what sustainable building is based on basic knowledge of architectural planning, structural planning, environment, planning, materials and construction planning. Learn the requirements of sustainable architecture and the means to achieve them. The goal is to be able to set planning, design, construction and maintenance standards for sustainable buildings. Students will also learn about sustainable architecture in cooperation with the local community.
advice: 1. Learn what is sustainable. (Terms, historical background, construction market trends) 2. Learn what building evaluation is. (Overview of building evaluation, evaluation items of various buildings, green buildings in each country) 3. Learn about the elements of sustainable architecture. (Long life, coexistence with nature, energy saving, resource saving / circulation saving, inheritance, etc.) 4. Learn what life cycle management is. (Life cycle cost, facility management, building diagnosis / long-term maintenance plan) Lectures and case studies based on handouts will be provided. Preparing and reviewing the contents of lectures using handouts to deepen understanding.
requiredKnowledge: To read architectural magazines (new architecture, Nikkei Architecture, etc.) and newspapers from everyday, and to know the social trends surrounding architecture.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can easily explain what sustainable architecture is. Also, the elements for sustainable architecture can be reflected in planning and planning.
achievementLevels.standard: Students will be able to understand the meaning of sustainable architecture and give several examples. In addition, we can explain some factors that make the building sustainable.

lessons.content: About the idea of sustainable. Examples of sustainable buildings. (Overview)

Social Background for Sustainable Architecture (1) The relationship between population decline, low birthrate and aging and architecture. The relationship between changes in the global environment and energy conservation.
Social Background for Sustainable Architecture (2) Trends in the construction market (transition from flow society to stock society.
Building evaluation. An introduction to architectural examples about the evaluation of buildings that change with the times.
● Examination (1st to 4th lecture contents) Sustainable architecture overview Explanation of test contents
lessons.operation: Lecture on test content Written test Self-check
lessons.assignments: Preparation and review. Increase the level of understanding of the contents of the first to fourth lectures.

lessons.content: Nature symbiosis and architecture. Conservation of biodiversity and ecosystem, biotope, rooftop greening, wall greening)
Energy conservation and architecture. (1) Japan's energy consumption and CO2 emissions, utilization of renewable energy, climate and construction.
Energy conservation and architecture. (2) Energy-saving building concept. (CO2 reduction in each phase of planning, design, construction and operation)
About extending the life of a building. Skeleton infill concept. Earthquake resistance of existing buildings.
Review of the first half ● Test (The contents of the 6th to 9th lectures. Measure your understanding of energy-saving architecture and nature-friendly architecture)
lessons.operation: 6 to 9 lecture content tests Lectures and questions Self-check
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of lectures 6 to 9 to improve understanding

lessons.content: Reconstruction of architecture . (1) Reconstruction methods and types of architecture, regeneration by creating new value. Report on renovation, conversion renovation architecture, conversion architecture examples
Reconstruction of architecture . (2) The process of building regeneration. (Planning stage, design stage, construction stage, operation stage)

Reconstruction of architecture (3) Introduction of the latest building regeneration case. Maintenance of architecture. Architecture life cycle management. Architectural diagnosis and long-term maintenance.
● In-test report About reconstruction of architecture.
Review of the entire lecture. Check the good and bad points of the test and report results.
